SELECT TOP 5
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.DueDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipDate,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.Status,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OnlineOrderFlag,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderNumber,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.PurchaseOrderNumber,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.AccountNumber,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CustomerID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesPersonID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TerritoryID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.BillToAddressID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipToAddressID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ShipMethodID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CreditCardID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CreditCardApprovalCode,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.CurrencyRateID,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SubTotal,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TaxAmt,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.Freight,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.Comment,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.rowguid,
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.ModifiedDate
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
ORDER BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue DESC
